Verified: Chat::handleToolCalls() no longer calls executeToolsParallel() at all -- src/Chat.php ~line 293 has an explicit '// R14b: executeToolsParallel()/AgentWorkerPool routing is disabled unconditionally' comment, and all tool calls now execute sequentially in-process. executeToolsParallel() itself is left in place but marked DISABLED with an @todo pointing at the real fix (a name-keyed tool registry the worker process can use, since closures can't cross a process boundary). tests/ChatTest.php::testMultipleToolCallsWithPoolConfiguredExecuteRealToolsSequentially confirms real tool output now appears even with 2+ tool calls and a pool configured.

This is a deliberate feature-disable, not a full fix -- parallel tool-call execution itself remains unimplemented/out-of-scope by design per the plan's own text ('a bigger future redesign, out of scope for this pass'). Counted as done because disabling the broken path to stop silent data corruption was the correct scoped outcome, matching the R19/R20 disclosed-limitation precedent.

Verified: bin/sugarcrush is now just autoload + Bootstrap::chat() + Program::run(); Bootstrap::chat() (src/Cli/Bootstrap.php) constructs a real EnhancedSessionStore, MemoryStore, and shares one InstructionFileLoader instance across Read/Edit/Glob. tests/Integration/BinSugarcrushWiringTest.php exercises this directly (session.db file creation, memory dir creation, shared-instance InstructionFileLoader assertions).

Disclosed CommandBackend-path gap (per this item's known scope): Bootstrap::backend() builds $tools (with the shared InstructionFileLoader) unconditionally, but those tools -- and therefore the InstructionFileLoader wiring -- are only ever attached to the EngineBackend construction path. When $SUGARCRUSH_BACKEND_CMD selects CommandBackend instead, CommandBackend is constructed with no tools/hooks at all, so nested-instruction injection for Read/Edit/Glob is unreachable on that path. BinSugarcrushWiringTest only covers the EngineBackend/default path, not CommandBackend. Also disclosed via BinSugarcrushWiringTest::testChatHasNoAgentManagerSinceBootstrapDoesNotConstructOne: Bootstrap::chat() never constructs/passes an agentManager, which is the root cause behind several of R20's disclosed gaps below.
